description: This Perl package provides functions to handle path transformations for cross-platform testing of curl on Windows and Unix-like systems, including path normalization, conversion to native Windows paths, and building absolute paths in various formats.

methods.name: os_is_win
methods.description: Returns true if the operating system is a Windows variant.

methods.name: exe_ext
methods.description: Returns the executable file extension for the OS, e.g., '.exe' on Windows.

methods.name: sys_native_abs_path
methods.description: Returns absolute path in native system format, converting relative paths as needed.

methods.name: sys_native_current_path
methods.description: Returns the current working directory in native system format.

methods.name: build_sys_abs_path
methods.description: Builds an absolute path in Unix style for testing purposes, considering Windows paths.

methods.name: normalize_path
methods.description: Normalizes a path string by resolving '.' and '..' components, converting slashes, and removing duplicates.
